scope:
720 exact relocated single saved-value CR1b write models; no physical or cache proof.
Only selectors, CR1f57, sequencer1 and paired80d3 writes are permitted.
One saved85 data write only; no encoder/timing/clock writes; independent whole-image and I/O-order checks.
